title: glyceria distans var. arctica
intro: Glyceria distans var. arctica, commonly known as Northern Fowl Manna Grass, is a type of grass belonging to the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Glyceria distans var. arctica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
